english: The pair of tangents drawn from the point $P(3,6)$ to the ellipse $\dfrac{x^{2}}{7}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{2}=1$ meets the $y$-axis at the points $A$ and $B$. Then the area of the triangle $PAB$ is ______.
hindi: बिन्दु $P(3,6)$ से दीर्घवृत्त $\dfrac{x^{2}}{7}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{2}=1$ पर खींचा गया स्पर्श रेखा युग्म $y$-अक्ष को बिन्दुओं $A$ तथा $B$ पर मिलता है। तब त्रिभुज $PAB$ का क्षेत्रफल ______ है।
solution_full: The combined equation of the pair of tangents from $P$ is $SS_1=T^{2}$, where $S=\dfrac{x^{2}}{7}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{2}-1$ and $T=\dfrac{3x}{7}+\dfrac{6y}{2}-1=\dfrac{3x}{7}+3y-1$.
Points of this pair on the $y$-axis: put $x=0$: $\dfrac{128}{7}\left(\dfrac{y^{2}}{2}-1\right)=(3y-1)^{2}$. Multiply by $7$: $64y^{2}-128=63y^{2}-42y+7$, so $y^{2}+42y-135=0$.
$(y-3)(y+45)=0$: the tangents meet the $y$-axis at $A(0,3)$ and $B(0,-45)$ (one on each tangent, since the pair meets $x=0$ in two distinct points and $P$ is not on $x=0$).
Check with slopes: the tangents are $y=x+3$ (slope $1$, $c^{2}=9=7+2$) and $y=17x-45$ (slope $17$, $c^{2}=2025=7\cdot289+2$).
$AB=48$ and the distance of $P$ from the $y$-axis is $3$, so the area of $\triangle PAB$ is $\dfrac12\cdot48\cdot3=72$.
originality_note: New: the intercepts of both tangents on an axis are read from one quadratic obtained by cutting the joint equation SS1 = T^2 with x = 0, without finding the tangents (way 5). Closest known: equation of the pair of tangents; area of the triangle formed by the tangents and the chord of contact. Different because: the triangle has its base on the y-axis, and the joint-equation route avoids the slopes. Standard ingredient.
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, point and curve introduced, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer matches the plan. Checked that P is outside, that the two y-intercepts are distinct and belong to different tangents, and that the area is exact. Changed: No change.
key_step: Put x = 0 in SS1 = T^2 to get y^2 + 42y - 135 = 0.
justification: Routine: joint equation of the pair of tangents, one substitution, a quadratic and an area. Comparable to 2024-P2-Q7 (L2), tangents from a point with lengths.

concept_use.Pair of tangents for Ellipse: The joint equation SS1 = T^2 of the pair of tangents from P(3,6) is cut by x = 0 to give both y-intercepts from y^2 + 42y - 135 = 0.
